Note: The American Community Survey asks respondents about health insurance coverage for each person in the household. A person is considered insured if they have marked "Yes" for at least one of the comprehensive coverage types (insurance through a current or former employer; insurance purchased directly from an insurance company; TRICARE or military health care; Medicare; Medicaid or government assistance plans; or VA healthcare).
:::
